reservationNote: Reserved-after-implementation cases are excluded from subsequent prompt tuning, not a blind pre-implementation benchmark.

cases.task: Fix src/clamp.mjs: clamp(value, min, max) must return min below the inclusive lower bound, max above the upper bound, and the unchanged number inside the interval. Inputs are finite numbers with min <= max. Preserve the export and avoid unrelated changes.

Fix slug(text) in src/slug.mjs. Trim leading/trailing whitespace, lowercase the text and replace each run of whitespace (spaces, tabs and newlines) with one hyphen. Do not strip non-whitespace characters. The empty/whitespace-only input returns an empty string. Preserve the export.

Fix discountedTotal(amount, discount) in src/discount.mjs. The default discount is 0.1 only when discount is undefined. An explicit zero must mean no discount; other supplied rates must be used unchanged. Inputs are valid finite numbers. Preserve the export and existing default behavior.

Fix paginate(items, page, size) in src/paginate.mjs. Pages are one-based and contain at most size items, with no overlap. Beyond the last page return an empty array and never mutate items. Preserve the RangeError for nonpositive or noninteger page/size and the named export.

Change the contract of parseAmount(text) in src/amount.mjs from currency units to integer cents, rounded with Math.round(Number(text) * 100). Then update its consumer invoiceLabel(text) in src/invoice.mjs to preserve the existing display EUR followed by two decimal places. Do not change either export. Establish the producer contract before adapting the consumer.

Migrate tokenize(text) in src/tokens.mjs to return { tokens: string[], count: number } instead of an array. Whitespace-delimited nonempty tokens must be preserved; blank input gives empty tokens/count zero. Then adapt wordCount(text) in src/count.mjs to the new result while preserving its numeric API. Preserve named exports.

Change findUser(users, id) in src/users.mjs to return { found: true, item: matchingUser } on a match and { found: false, item: null } otherwise. Then update greeting(users, id) in src/greeting.mjs to consume that contract, preserving Hello NAME for a match and Unknown user otherwise. Match IDs with strict equality and preserve named exports.

Migrate loadConfig(env) in src/config.mjs from flat host/port fields to { server: { host, port } }. Preserve defaults localhost and 3000 and numeric conversion of a supplied PORT. Then update baseUrl(env) in src/url.mjs to consume the nested contract while preserving http://HOST:PORT output. Keep the existing named exports.

Fix two independent modules without changing their exports: mean(values) in src/mean.mjs must return zero for an empty numeric array and the arithmetic average otherwise. maximum(values) in src/maximum.mjs must return null for an empty array and the largest supplied value otherwise, including all-negative arrays. Each change can be implemented independently.

Fix the independent HTML helpers. escapeText(text) in src/text.mjs must escape every &, < and >, in that order, and preserve quotes. escapeAttribute(text) in src/attribute.mjs must escape every & and double quote as & and ", preserving other characters. Avoid double-escaping entities introduced by the helper itself. Preserve the named exports.

Fix two independent formatters. utcDate(date) in src/date.mjs must format a valid Date as YYYY-MM-DD using UTC fields and zero-padded month/day. duration(seconds) in src/duration.mjs receives a nonnegative integer and must return total minutes followed by a colon and exactly two digits for remaining seconds, for example 65 -> 1:05. Preserve exports.

Fix independent collection helpers. unique(values) in src/unique.mjs must remove duplicate strings preserving first appearance order and not mutate its input. countOccurrences(values) in src/counts.mjs must return a plain object of exact occurrence counts for arbitrary string keys, including constructor and __proto__, without prototype mutation. Preserve exports.
